reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Google account
reauth_confirm.description: Authorization must be renewed so the integration can also read the signed-in Google account email. Your existing integration and options are retained.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one account can be configured.

application_credentials.description: Create a Google OAuth 2.0 client of type web application, enable the People API and add {redirect_url} as redirect URI.

init.title: Options
init.description:
Contact entities and title formats of calendar entries.

Placeholders: {name}, {first_name}, {last_name}, {type}, {age}, {year}. Text in square brackets is left out when one of its placeholders is empty.

Examples: Geburtstag {name}[ - {age}] or {type} {name}[ ({age}. Jahr)]. {type} is e.g. the anniversary label or the name of your own event type.

data_description.create_contact_entities: Off: no contact devices/entities are created; calendar sync remains available.
data_description.title_format_event: Used for anniversaries, other and custom events.

error.invalid_title_format: Invalid title format. Only the placeholders listed above, at least one name placeholder, square brackets in pairs and not nested.

sync_failed.title: Calendar sync for {calendar} failed

legacy_integration_installed.title: Old integration still configured
legacy_integration_installed.description: The predecessor integration ({legacy_domain}) is still configured. Delete it under Settings → Devices & services, remove its folder from custom_components and switch automations to the actions of {domain}. This notice disappears on the next load once the old integration is removed.
